action: Mechanism study: (a) info in a 2-frame clip vs frame spacing (diag_gap.py), (b) val L0 with motion removed (mech.py)
effect: log T readable from a clip: R2 0.70/0.84/0.90/0.83/0.38/0.02 at spacing 5/10/20/40/80/160 substeps. Current spacing 80 is past the peak; longer gaps destroy it. Removing motion changes val L0 only 0.0439->0.0447; s moves 4%
relation_to_purpose: Identifies the exact gap: frame spacing too long (dots can no longer be matched) and level-0 loss has no incentive to keep motion
